text: {"subject":"Claim C020914 past payer filing limit, write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead, claim C020914 (patient PT0282, service code T1005, 16 units, billed $76.80, date of service 2026-11-06) was submitted 2027-01-02, 57 days after care.
